about: Minecraft brewing ingredients that become Schedule I mixers. Names, icons and sounds are read from the player's own Minecraft copy at runtime; nothing from Minecraft is shipped.

columns.id: Schedule I item ID registered by the mod
columns.mc_lang_keys: Keys tried in order in the player's Minecraft en_us.json for the display name
columns.mc_texture: Icon texture path inside the player's Minecraft client jar
columns.effect: Effect the ingredient imprints (effects sheet id)
columns.mc_basis: The Minecraft brewing rule the row is based on
columns.price: Purchase price in Schedule I dollars
columns.clone_from: Vanilla Schedule I mixer whose stored body (world model) and category are reused
columns.shop: Shop group that sells it (shops sheet id)
columns.description: Tooltip text written for the mashup

rows.mc_basis: Nether Wart turns a Water Bottle into an Awkward Potion, the base for every effect potion
rows.description: Brew this in first. It makes the batch Awkward, the base every other Minecraft ingredient needs.

rows.mc_basis: Awkward Potion + Sugar = Potion of Swiftness
rows.description: Swiftness in a pinch. Brew into an Awkward batch for Energizing.

rows.mc_basis: Awkward Potion + Spider Eye = Potion of Poison
rows.description: Poison, straight from a cave spider. Brew into an Awkward batch for Toxic.

rows.mc_basis: Redstone carries power in Minecraft; here it charges the batch
rows.description: Live wire dust. Brew into an Awkward batch for Electrifying.

rows.mc_basis: Awkward Potion + Glistering Melon Slice = Potion of Healing
rows.description: Healing, gold-flecked. Brew into an Awkward batch for Refreshing.

rows.mc_basis: Awkward Potion + Golden Carrot = Potion of Night Vision
rows.description: Night Vision in a carrot. Brew into an Awkward batch for Bright-Eyed.

rows.mc_basis: Fermented Spider Eye corrupts potions: Swiftness to Slowness, Night Vision to Invisibility, Healing to Harming; on its own it brews Weakness
rows.description: Corrupts what's already in the batch, the Minecraft way. No Awkward base needed.

rows.mc_basis: Gunpowder turns a potion into a Splash Potion
rows.description: Creeper leftovers. Brew into an Awkward batch for Explosive.

rows.mc_basis: Glowstone Dust powers up potions and lights the Nether
rows.description: Nether light, ground fine. Brew into an Awkward batch for Glowing.

rows.mc_basis: Awkward Potion + Rabbit's Foot = Potion of Leaping
rows.description: Leaping, for luck. Brew into an Awkward batch for Anti-Gravity.
